evidence: The thickness of the CdTe and MnTe layers (deduced from the fit of the experimental XRD proﬁles) for each SL is reported in Table 1. In all ALE samples, the MnTe thickness is close to 8 ML. This shows that, in the three growth modes described previously, all Mn atoms sent onto the surface during an ALE cycle stick to it. Thus, in contradiction with CdTe or MgTe, no self-regulated growth occurs for MnTe.
